hero.title: Make something beautiful with your own hands
hero.subtitle: Candles, ceramics, macramé and more: small, warm workshops where we learn and create together.

story.title: A place to create together
story.text: Every workshop is a small gathering: experienced instructors, carefully chosen materials and a warm, friendly room. Never tried it before? That's fine. Just come, and we'll make it together.

step1.title: Choose a workshop
step1.text: See the date, the place and the price, and pick the one for you.

step2.title: Reserve your place
step2.text: Sign up in a few steps; your place is held right away.

step3.title: Pay your way
step3.text: Cash, bank transfer or a payment link: whichever suits you.

step4.title: Come and create
step4.text: Everything is ready for you; take your own piece home.

footer.about: We hold small, friendly workshops in candle making, ceramics, macramé and many other crafts. Experienced instructors, good materials, and a piece of your own to take home.
